scripts.dev: concurrently "yarn workspace @project/webapp dev" "yarn workspace @project/shared dev" "yarn workspace @project/pb dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @project/shared test && yarn workspace @project/webapp test && yarn workspace @project/cli test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "yarn workspace @project/shared test:watch" "yarn workspace @project/webapp test:watch" "yarn workspace @project/cli test:watch"
scripts.precommit: yarn run format && yarn run lint && yarn run typecheck && yarn run test
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -R run clean && rm -rf pocketbase/pocketbase
